title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
author: Shoeybi et al. (2019)
why: The original column/row split for transformer MLP and attention blocks, with the f and g communication operators.

title: Efficient Large-Scale Language Model Training on GPU Clusters Using Megatron-LM
author: Narayanan et al. (SC 2021)
why: How to combine tensor, pipeline and data parallelism, the interleaved 1F1B schedule, and placement rules backed by measurements.

title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
author: Rajbhandari, Rasley, Ruwase and He (SC 2020)
why: The 16-bytes-per-parameter memory analysis and the three ZeRO stages with their communication volumes.

title: The Ultra-Scale Playbook: Training LLMs on GPU Clusters
author: Hugging Face (nanotron team)
why: A long, hands-on walkthrough of every parallelism dimension, including context and expert parallelism, with memory and timing plots.
